desk:
**BLUF:** The community focused on Ukrainian drone strikes hitting Russian targets, including a major fire at an Ozon warehouse in St. Petersburg, plus a Romanian F-16 downing a Russian drone over the Black Sea. The single most important development is the confirmed Ukrainian strike on the Ozon facility causing a catastrophic ongoing blaze.

## MAIN THREADS
### Ukrainian Drone Strike on St. Petersburg Ozon Warehouse
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2111691278693892203) and [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2111832406898692383) reported Ukrainian attack drones striking the Ozon e-commerce distribution center, with footage showing the site burning out of control.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111835791324266697) noted the strike in context of broader Russia-Ukraine developments.

### Romanian F-16 Intercepts Russian Drone
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2111786665568293361) shared cockpit footage of a Romanian Air Force F-16AM shooting down a Russian attack drone over the Black Sea.

### Fire at CFB Wainwright, Canada
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111734854727369132) posted footage of the massive explosion and fire at the Canadian base during a live-fire exercise, reporting seven killed and others injured, with unconfirmed reports of additional personnel parachuted in.

### Trump Endorses Netanyahu
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111835791324266697) reported U.S. President Trump’s official endorsement of Israeli PM Netanyahu ahead of elections, citing past support against Houthis and Iran.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- U.S. Air Force airman died in rappelling accident before UTSA vs Navy game [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2111829779091444044) (unconfirmed).
- UKMTO released Update 106 JMIC Advisory Note [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2111832406898692383) (unconfirmed details beyond link).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will track the Ozon fire’s spread and any Russian response; follow-up on Romanian drone intercepts; updates on the CFB Wainwright investigation and casualties.
